title: Employee offboarding
description: For a person leaving the organization or changing roles: access removed on time, responsibilities handed over and company assets returned.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations

rules.instruction: Ask the HR owner for the departure date, and list in the offboarding checklist every account and access to remove on that date (NIST SP 800-53, PS-4 Personnel Termination).
rules.verification: Compare the access review after the departure date with the checklist and confirm that each listed account is disabled.

rules.instruction: Before the departure, reassign the code ownership, on-call duties and shared credentials held by the departing person (NIST SP 800-53, PS-5 Personnel Transfer for a role change).
rules.verification: Check that CODEOWNERS, the on-call schedule and the secret store no longer name the departing person.

rules.instruction: Ask the manager to record the return of equipment and company data in the offboarding checklist.
rules.verification: Check that the checklist marks each listed item as returned or gives the follow-up owner.
